content:
Jamie: Hypatia wants an SSO+SCIM PoC next week: SAML (IdP & SP), SCIM user+group provisioning, role mapping (Admin/Agent/Viewer), and domain proof for 3 domains.
Olivia: Clarify bulk vs delta?
Jamie: Both - initial bulk import then delta sync. Group provisioning required.
Rahul: Recommend bulk off-peak for ~8k users, chunked requests and delta tokens for ongoing. Limit PoC to <=50 ops/sec sustained and honor Retry-After.
Morgan: Security asks: prefer HSM but accept cloud KMS with SOC attestation. Audit log retention 365d requested (hosted default 90d; enterprise addon available).
Kevin: Commercials: 30-day PoC estimate depends on tokens/ops. If they want 365d retention for PoC, add-on fee applies. Dedicated trial pricing differs.
Olivia: I'll draft a SCIM runbook with example payloads and test cases.
Jamie: Action list: Olivia runbook, Rahul sync plan + rate limits, Morgan annex draft, Kevin pricing. Kickoff Wed 10am PT.
